dct_description_sm:
The file contains the following variables and units of measurement: 
Latitude and Longitude (decimal degree)
Sediment Accumulation Rate (SAR; mm/year)
Mass Accumulation Rate (MAR; g/cm2/year)

Available datasets include the spatial coordinates and the digitized temporal rates of lake sedimentation expressed as Sediment Accumulation Rates (SAR; mm/year) and Mass Accumulation Rate (MAR; g/cm2/year) digitized from the Journal of Paleolimnology between 1989 to 2016CE and presented in Baud et al. (2021).
dct_title_s: Global sedimentation rate database digitized from the Journal of paleolimnology [1989 - 2016]
